payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks for improving performance in abstractive document summarization.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, as it requires comprehensive understanding of a document, which is crucial for summarization.
SR outperforms the other two tasks (Next Sentence Generation and Masked Document Generation) in terms of effectiveness for pre-training.
Using SR for pre-training leads to significant improvements in ROUGE-2 scores on summarization datasets compared to other tasks.
